findings.note: A Sep 20, 2026 RotoWire/CBS note says Farabee should get a bigger role in 2026-27 after Blake Coleman was traded, and he skated on Mikael Backlund's second-line wing in camp. It also expects Calgary to finish near the bottom of the standings.

Last season Farabee scored 38 points (20 goals) in 82 games while playing in all situations. Late-season notes said he had top-six minutes but recently no power-play time, which limited his scoring, and he went four straight games without a point before his last game.
Farabee had two goals and an assist in a 5-4 win over Carolina on Mar 8, 2026. The same page also shows streaky output, including several six-game point droughts on a low-scoring Flames team.
